clips.name: weave
clips.alt: Weave on black at its default settings: grey wool threads are pulled in one by one, first the upright warps from the left, then the wefts row by row, until a woven sheet hangs turned three quarters to the camera and breathes in a light wind
clips.caption: Weave at its default settings, on black: the net is finished after four seconds.

clips.name: weave-presets
clips.alt: Four Weave presets on black in a grid, in sync: Burlap top left, a pale, coarse and crooked weave whose corners have frayed away; Red Sail top right, an even red cloth that bows and sways in strong gusts; Nest bottom left, a round patch of brown, fuzzy wool; Qualle bottom right, a cream knitted jellyfish whose bell pulses and whose long ribbons curl
clips.caption: The four presets on black, in sync.

clips.name: weave-weave-speed
clips.alt: The grey net weaving itself in at three speeds side by side, in sync from the clip start: at Weave Speed 0.5 only the first warps are in after five seconds, at 1 the net is finished after four seconds, at 2.5 after about one and a half
clips.caption: Weave Speed 0.5, 1 and 2.5, each from the clip start.
clips.note: Three exports of the same range from clip start, one per value (doc-clip cannot make a value grid yet): made as single clips with --keep, laid out with --reencode as a presets grid (ledger, GEN1).

clips.name: weave-reveal
clips.alt: The grey net while Reveal runs from 0 to 1 and back: a small round patch with a frayed rim grows from the middle until the whole sheet is there, then shrinks to nothing; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Reveal from 0 to 1 and back.

clips.name: weave-irregularity
clips.alt: The grey net while Irregularity runs from 0 to 3 and back: the even grid turns crooked, the threads wander and bunch with uneven gaps and thick, fuzzy places, then it straightens again; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Irregularity from 0 to 3 and back.

clips.name: weave-wind
clips.alt: The grey net, turned three quarters, at three wind strengths, two and a half seconds each: at Wind 0 it hangs flat and still, at 0.5 it bows gently and breathes with the gusts, at 2 it bellies out hard and its free edges sway; the value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Wind 0, 0.5 and 2, two and a half seconds each.

clips.name: weave-pulse-rate
clips.alt: The Qualle jellyfish at three pulse rates side by side, in sync: at 0 the bell stays still and only the ribbons drift, at 0.4 Hz it contracts slowly, at 1.2 Hz quickly
clips.caption: Pulse Rate 0, 0.4 and 1.2 Hz, side by side.
clips.note: Three exports of the same range from clip start, one per value (doc-clip cannot make a value grid yet): made as single clips with --keep, laid out with --reencode as a presets grid (ledger, GEN1).

clips.name: weave-pulse-size
clips.alt: The Qualle jellyfish while Pulse Size runs from 0 to 0.6 and back: the round bell starts to contract and stretch the body with each pulse, more and more, then calms again; the value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Pulse Size from 0 to 0.6 and back.

clips.name: weave-curl-strength
clips.alt: The Qualle jellyfish while Curl Strength runs from 0 to 0.25 and back: the smooth hanging ribbons begin to swirl and loop outwards on both sides, then settle into calm loops again; the value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Curl Strength from 0 to 0.25 and back.

clips.name: flocking
clips.alt: Flocking on black at its default settings: a cloud of fine pale blue points flies as one swarm, folds, splits into two lobes and gathers again in the middle of the frame
clips.caption: Flocking at its default settings (Free Swarm), on black.
clips.note: Flocking acts on its swarm graph, not on effect params, so doc-clip cannot export it yet: the exports come from a helper that applies the flock preset and keys the named card control ("flock"), then `--reencode --keep <folder>` encodes them.

clips.name: flocking-presets
clips.alt: Five Flocking swarms on black in a grid of three and two, in sync: Free Swarm, a cloud of pale blue points; Krill Cloud, orange krill swimming in clusters; Follow Path, a school tracing a figure eight with fine trails; Technical Network, points joined by blue lines in a flat band; Violet Filaments, a violet cloud with curved filaments and small wire cubes
clips.caption: The five presets on black, in sync.
clips.note: Flocking acts on its swarm graph, not on effect params, so doc-clip cannot export it yet: the exports come from a helper (review/GEN1/flock/export.mjs, r2.json) that applies the flock preset and sets the named card control for each cell ("flock"), then `--reencode --keep <folder>` lays them out as a grid.

clips.name: flocking-population
clips.alt: The Free Swarm with three populations, two seconds each: 500 sparse points, the default 4000, and 20000 points that read as a dense, glowing cloud; the number is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Population 500, 4000 and 20000, two seconds each.
clips.note: Flocking acts on its swarm graph, not on effect params, so doc-clip cannot export it yet: the exports come from a helper that applies the flock preset and keys the named card control ("flock"), then `--reencode --keep <folder>` encodes them.

clips.caption: Cohesion 0, 1 (default) and 10, side by side.
